contract: The fuel vocabulary, as DATA because it is the domain owner's list and changes with her sheet rather than with this app. Each entry is one cleaned fuel: the `group` it falls in for the five-bucket column, the `color` it is drawn in, and every `spelling` that resolves to it. Spellings are matched on the NORMALISED cell -- trimmed, lower-cased, runs of whitespace collapsed -- and must be unique across the whole file; `src/tables/generator/fuel.ts` refuses to load if one repeats, because a duplicate spelling would silently pick whichever entry was read last. A spelling listed nowhere here still resolves through that file's pattern cascade; only a value that matches neither reads as Unrecognised. `group` must be one of the five in FUEL_GROUPS -- Solar, Wind, Hydro, Storage, Thermal. The Unknown/Unlisted/Unrecognised states are not fuels and are not listed here.
provenance: Seeded from the domain owner's `Fuel Type Groupings` sheet (37 rows), under standard names: her `Sun` is Solar and her `Water` is Hydro here. Two changes were made to it deliberately, each marked `note` below.

fuels.note: Most pumped units are caught by the marker scan in fuel.ts rather than by a spelling here, because their FuelType says plain hydro and only SubType, Technology or the unit's name gives them away.
`mwh` is the domain owner's rule: the modeller writes the storage quantity's unit where a fuel name goes.
Kept apart from Natural Gas because her sheet keeps it apart. It is a prime mover rather than a fuel, which is why the five-bucket column is the one to read when that distinction is not wanted.
NOT on her sheet. Residual oil is a different fuel from distillate and reading it as distillate would be a wrong answer rather than a missing one.

`wds` is CORRECTED from her sheet, which maps it to Water. WDS is Wood/Wood Waste Solids in the EIA vocabulary, and a wood boiler summed into the hydro fleet is a wrong answer. If her sheet is right and this is wrong, this one spelling moves back and the fixture beside it moves with it.

Its own fuel, and listed BEFORE nothing in particular -- the reason it exists is that `hydrogen` contains `hydro`, so a pattern that read it as water would stack hydrogen into the hydro band with nothing said.
